title: Slices of Summer Cake  (Porciones de pastel de verano)

segments.t: En el alegre mostrador del café, Tessa corta porciones doradas, coronadas de rubí, del pastel de verano de bayas y almendras y las sirve en platos de gres, mientras Hannah y Owen regresan a toda prisa con bandejas vacías y los ojos brillantes. Escuchemos primero la escena.
Tell me everything right now — did table one taste the berry almond cake yet?!
He took one small bite, closed both eyes, and tapped his hand over his heart!
Then he nodded twice to Arthur and wrote two words on his napkin: Exact match!
EXACT MATCH! Did you hear that, kitchen ovens?! Honey and orange zest won the day!
Number ten from next door said it tastes like May afternoon sunshine thirty years back.
And every single neighbor clipped their numbered birch clothespin onto their lapel like a badge!
Even that soggy poster accident turned into the hit fashion trend of Linden Street!
Here go six more slices for table three — save two big corners for the musicians!
Listen — Evelyn and Caleb just sat down side by side on the walnut piano bench!
Turn down the tea kettle burner so the whole courtyard hears every single note!
Come stand by the archway with us, Tessa — the ovens earned a five-minute break!
Wiping my hands right now — play us home, Room Nine!
Vamos ahora línea por línea con este triunfo de la cocina.
Tell me everything right now — did table one taste the berry almond cake yet?!
'¡Cuéntenmelo todo ahora mismo! ¿Ya probó la mesa uno el pastel de bayas y almendras?'
He took one small bite, closed both eyes, and tapped his hand over his heart!
'¡Dio un bocadito, cerró los dos ojos y se dio unos golpecitos con la mano sobre el corazón!'
Then he nodded twice to Arthur and wrote two words on his napkin: Exact match!
'Luego asintió dos veces mirando a Arthur y escribió dos palabras en su servilleta: ¡igualito!'
EXACT MATCH! Did you hear that, kitchen ovens?! Honey and orange zest won the day!
'¡IGUALITO! ¿¡Lo oyeron, hornos de la cocina!? ¡La miel y la ralladura de naranja se llevaron la victoria!'
Number ten from next door said it tastes like May afternoon sunshine thirty years back.
'El del número diez de al lado dijo que sabe a una tarde soleada de mayo de hace treinta años.'
And every single neighbor clipped their numbered birch clothespin onto their lapel like a badge!
'¡Y todos los vecinos se prendieron su pinza numerada de abedul en la solapa como una insignia!'
Even that soggy poster accident turned into the hit fashion trend of Linden Street!
'¡Hasta aquel accidente del cartel empapado se convirtió en la moda de éxito de la calle Linden!'
Here go six more slices for table three — save two big corners for the musicians!
'Ahí van seis porciones más para la mesa tres: ¡guarden dos esquinas grandes para los músicos!'
Listen — Evelyn and Caleb just sat down side by side on the walnut piano bench!
'Escuchen: ¡Evelyn y Caleb acaban de sentarse uno al lado del otro en la banqueta del piano de nogal!'
Turn down the tea kettle burner so the whole courtyard hears every single note!
'¡Bajen el fuego de la tetera para que todo el patio oiga cada una de las notas!'
Come stand by the archway with us, Tessa — the ovens earned a five-minute break!
'Ven a quedarte junto al arco con nosotros, Tessa: ¡los hornos se ganaron un descanso de cinco minutos!'
Wiping my hands right now — play us home, Room Nine!
'Me estoy secando las manos ahora mismo: ¡llévanos a casa con tu música, habitación Nueve!'
Escuchemos la escena completa una vez más.
Tell me everything right now — did table one taste the berry almond cake yet?!
He took one small bite, closed both eyes, and tapped his hand over his heart!
Then he nodded twice to Arthur and wrote two words on his napkin: Exact match!
EXACT MATCH! Did you hear that, kitchen ovens?! Honey and orange zest won the day!
Number ten from next door said it tastes like May afternoon sunshine thirty years back.
And every single neighbor clipped their numbered birch clothespin onto their lapel like a badge!
Even that soggy poster accident turned into the hit fashion trend of Linden Street!
Here go six more slices for table three — save two big corners for the musicians!
Listen — Evelyn and Caleb just sat down side by side on the walnut piano bench!
Turn down the tea kettle burner so the whole courtyard hears every single note!
Come stand by the archway with us, Tessa — the ovens earned a five-minute break!
Wiping my hands right now — play us home, Room Nine!

Dos palabras en una servilleta, «idéntico, igualito», coronan el triunfo de la cocina de Tessa justo cuando cuatro manos tocan las teclas del piano de nogal. Nos vemos en la habitación nueve en la próxima escena.
See you next time!
